name: @earendil-works/openpi-desktop
description: Electron desktop app for OpenPI personal agent (no CLI required)

scripts.dev: npm run build:speech-helper && concurrently -k "vite --port 5179" "wait-on tcp:5179 && electron ."
scripts.desktop: npm run build:speech-helper && npm run build && OPENPI_DESKTOP_PROD=1 electron .
scripts.pack:dir: npm run build:speech-helper && npm run bundle:runtime && npm run build && electron-builder --dir --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.pack:mac: npm run build:speech-helper && npm run bundle:runtime && npm run build && electron-builder --mac --config electron-builder.yml
